name: Data Browser Engine Room (Web)
implementation_notes: EngineRoomRecordService/Controller/routes/factories/models/migrations are shared infrastructure for all 3 web Engine Room screens (097/107/117), mirroring StorageTankRecordService's precedent -- reported under this screen since it is first in the implementation sequence. Models/migrations were already generated in an earlier (Phase 1/entity-catalog) pass per the task brief; this pass verified them against the service/controller code (using the migration as ground truth for the exact column list) and found them consistent, requiring no changes

Engine Room follows the same hourly-grid (dynamic add-row/remove-row, 1..24 rows, unique + strictly ascending canonical time_slot) pattern as Storage Tank -- create()/update()/listRecords()/export()/getDetail(), plus canonicalTimeSlots() helper returning 24 'HH:00' strings starting 07:00

filled_slot_count computed via withCount() with an inner OR-whereNotNull constraint across all 27 non-time_slot columns -- mirrors StorageTankRecordService's filled_slot_count pattern; this station has NO identifying/context columns to exclude (no shift/inspector_id equivalent), so all 27 columns participate. This is the LARGEST field count of any station in this project

IMPORTANT -- enum empty-string-vs-null: 2 of the 27 detail columns (diesel_gen_1_status, diesel_gen_2_status) are backed by a SQLite CHECK constraint (Laravel enum()) that rejects an empty string. EngineRoomRecordService::normalizeDetails() coerces '' to null for these columns specifically before validation/persistence -- the same mitigation Kernel Dispatch/Effluent Plant/Storage Tank needed for their own enum columns. Proactively implemented per explicit task instruction (a prior station's enum columns hit a SQLite CHECK-constraint issue), verified by a dedicated unit test

DERIVED ASSUMPTION -- field count correction: the task brief stated 26 non-time_slot columns for this station, but the pre-generated migration files (2026_08_31_000015_create_engine_room_details_table.php) -- explicitly designated as ground truth -- contain 27 columns (2 enum status columns: diesel_gen_1_status, diesel_gen_2_status, not counted as 1). All code (backend + mobile) was generated against the migration's actual 27-column list

UNLIKE Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant: Engine Room has NO operational-target reference table -- no seeder, no model, no Target Operasional section anywhere in this station's 6 screens, per this task's explicit scope

The Engine Room tile in production-process-activity.blade.php (screen-035) was updated from a javascript:void(0) placeholder to route('data.engine-room') -- 3 of the 2026-08-31 batch (Clarification, Boiler Room, Process Quality Control) now remain unrouted, decremented from 4
tests/Feature/ProductionProcessActivityTest.php updated: Engine Room moved from the 'still-unrouted' test into the routed-tiles test (now asserts 11 active routed tiles, not 10)
StationFactory::engineRoom() state added additively (mirrors storageTank()/effluentPlant() exactly) for this screen's and screen-117's test suites

Ran the full backend test suite (`php artisan test`) after implementation: 1884 passed (0 failed), confirming no regression to any pre-existing screen. Engine-Room-specific tests (`--filter=EngineRoom`): 90 passed (0 failed) -- 33 unit (EngineRoomRecordServiceTest), 7 integration (Feature/Api/DataBrowserEngineRoomTest), 5 component (Feature/Livewire/DataBrowserEngineRoomTest), reported under this screen; remaining 45 Engine Room tests reported under screen-107/screen-117 below
